description: This file contains unit tests for the MigraDoc library, specifically testing table creation, cloning, borders, and rendering within the MigraDoc.Tests namespace using the Xunit framework.

classes.name: TableTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple test methods for creating and manipulating tables in MigraDoc, including table cloning and border styling.

methods.name: Create_Table_Cell_with_Top_Border
methods.description: Test method that creates a document with a table having a top border on a cell, renders it to PDF, and saves the output.

methods.name: Create_a_cloned_table
methods.description: Test method that creates a document with a table, clones it, and verifies cloning functionality by rendering to PDF.

methods.name: Create_a_table_with_cloned_rows
methods.description: Test method that creates a table, clones specific rows, adds them back, and renders the document to verify cloning of rows.
